title: 4 Mi to Dtwn: Goodlettsville Getaway w/ Yard
description:
Pet Friendly w/ Fee | Great for Kids | Antiquing Nearby | Day Trip to Nashville

Find your next family getaway in Goodlettsville! Surrounded by relaxing wooded views, this 3-bed, 2-bath vacation rental makes a great place to unwind and reconnect with loved ones. After breakfast in the home's full kitchen, head out to get lost in the local antique shops, stroll acres of hiking trails at Moss-Wright Park, or visit some of Nashville's renowned attractions. There's no wrong way to do Tennessee!

The space
SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS
- Bedroom 1: 1 king bed
- Bedroom 2: 1 full bed
- Bedroom 3: 2 twin beds w/ 1 twin trundle

HOME HIGHLIGHTS
- Smart TV
- Group-friendly dining table
- Kids' playroom  
- Large unfenced yard

KITCHEN
- Refrigerator, stove/oven, dishwasher
- Drip coffee maker, microwave
- Cooking basics, dishware & flatware

GENERAL
- Free WiFi, keyless entry
- Central A/C & heating, ceiling fans
- Washer & dryer, iron & board
- Linens & towels, trash bags & paper towels
- Complimentary toiletries

FAQ
- Pet fee (paid pre-trip)

ACCESSIBILITY
- Step-free access via ramp (entrance & common areas)
- 36-in wide doorways & entrances
- 2-story home
- Bedrooms/bathrooms on 1st floor

PARKING
- Carport (2 vehicles)
- Driveway (2 vehicles)

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire property via keyless entry

Other things to note
- No smoking
- Pet friendly w/ $50 fee (+ fees & taxes, 2 max)
- No events, parties, or large gatherings
- Additional fees and taxes may apply
- Photo ID may be required upon check-in

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
- This 2-story home offers step-free access via a ramp through the garage. Entrances and doorways are 36 inches wide, and there are 2 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms on the 1st floor
